p5.js 2.3.4

File in this folder: p5.min.js, an unmodified copy of lib/p5.min.js from the
p5 npm package, version 2.3.4 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/p5/v/2.3.4).

License: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 (LGPL-2.1).
The full license text is in p5.LICENSE.txt, next to this file.

The complete corresponding source code for this version is available at:
https://github.com/processing/p5.js/tree/v2.3.4

p5.min.js is a separate file that index.html loads with its own <script> tag.
It is not merged with any other code. As the LGPL allows, it can be replaced
with another build of p5.js, modified or not.

p5.min.js also contains code from these libraries, with their own licenses:
acorn and acorn-walk (MIT), colorjs.io (MIT), escodegen (BSD-2-Clause) with
estraverse and esutils (BSD-2-Clause) and source-map (BSD-3-Clause), gifenc
(MIT), omggif (MIT), i18next and i18next-browser-languagedetector (MIT),
libtess (SGI Free Software License B 2.0), pako (MIT and Zlib), Typr.js (MIT),
@davepagurek/bezier-path (MIT), @japont/unicode-range (MIT), and the webgl-noise
GLSL code by Stefan Gustavson (MIT). See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the root of
this repository.
